```{r setup, results='hide', message=FALSE}
## load packages:
library(data.table)
library(writexl)
library(lubridate)
library(arsenal)
library(CRP)

## Load functions:
source("20_functions/source_dir.R")
source_dir("20_functions")
```


## Read data 

Read file compiled in `01_prepare_data.Rmd`:
```{r}
d0 <- get_derived_data()
```

Read file compiled in `11_derive_variables.Rmd`:
```{r}
adat <- get_analysis_data()
```

Read file compiled in `22_mk_baseline_data.Rmd`:
```{r}
# Baseline data
dbl <- readRDS(file="02_data_derived/baselinedata.rds")
```

Read files compiled in `23_derive_adverse_events.Rmd`:
```{r}
# Adverse events data
de <- readRDS(file = "02_data_derived/adverse_events_derived.rds")

# Suicide attempts data
ds <- readRDS("02_data_derived/suicides_by_visits_derived.rds")

# Hospital contacts and deaths data
dc <- readRDS("02_data_derived/admissions_derived.rds")
```

Read exception ID numbers:
```{r}
except <- readRDS(file = "02_data_derived/exceptions.rds")
```


## Checks on data from `01_prepare_data.Rmd`

Check that all randomized subjects in full dataset has `ranmed_cmpl == "Complete"`:
```{r}
dd0 <- d0[c_visit == "day0" & !is.na(rand_id)]
dd0[, max_rep_inst := max(rep_inst), ID]
stopifnot(dd0[max_rep_inst == rep_inst, all(ranmed_cmpl == "Complete")])
```

Check multiple day 0 dates:
```{r}
d1 <- d0[c_visit == "day0" & 
           variable %in% c("medicin_udl_dato", "forsoegsmedicin_startdato"),
         .(ID, date = d_value, date_var = variable, rep_inst, rand_id)]
d1[date_var == "forsoegsmedicin_startdato", 
   `:=`(date_var = paste0(date_var, " -1"),
        date = date -1)]

d <- rbind(
  unique(d0[c_visit == "day0", .(ID, date, date_var, rep_inst, rand_id)]),
  unique(d1))

setorder(d, ID, date, rep_inst)
d[, max_rep_inst := max(rep_inst), ID]
d[, no_dates := uniqueN(date), .(ID, rep_inst)]
id_w_mult_day0 <- d[no_dates > 1 & rep_inst == max_rep_inst & !is.na(rand_id),
                    sort(unique(ID))]

# Expected subjects with multiple day0 dates:
stopifnot(length(except$expected_id_w_mult_day0) == 2L)

## Check that only 2 specific IDs have multiple day0 dates:
if(!isTRUE(setequal(id_w_mult_day0, except$expected_id_w_mult_day0))) {
  warning("Unexpected ID with multiple day0 dates")
  ## Date trouble:
  d_mult0 <- d[no_dates > 1 & rep_inst == max_rep_inst & !is.na(rand_id) &
                    !ID %in% except$expected_id_w_mult_day0]
  dlst <- split(d_mult0[, .(date_var = paste(date_var, collapse = ", ")), 
                        by = setdiff(names(d_mult0), "date_var")], by="ID")
  print(names(dlst))
  write_xlsx(x=dlst, path = paste0("04_data_checks/", get_datetime_from_checksums(),
                                   "_trouble_with_day0_dates.xlsx"))
}
```

Check for multiple day 4, 7, 14, 28 or month 6 dates:
```{r}
dd <- unique(d0[!c_visit %in% c("screen", "deviations", "events"), 
                .(ID, date, date_var, rep_inst, rand_id, c_visit)])
setorder(dd, ID, c_visit, date, rep_inst)
dd[, max_rep_inst := max(rep_inst), .(ID, c_visit)]
dd[, no_dates := uniqueN(date), .(ID, rep_inst, c_visit)]

## Check that only 3 specific ID has multiple dates (other visits than day0):
##       'c_visit' != "day0".
id_w_mult_days <- dd[no_dates > 1 & rep_inst == max_rep_inst & !is.na(rand_id) & 
                       c_visit != "day0", sort(unique(ID))]
stopifnot(length(except$expected_id_w_mult_days) == 3L)

if(!isTRUE(setequal(id_w_mult_days, except$expected_id_w_mult_days))) {
  warning("Unexpected ID with multiple dates for a visit")
  d_mult_pbl <- dd[no_dates > 1 & rep_inst == max_rep_inst & !is.na(rand_id) &
                    !ID %in% except$expected_id_w_mult_days & c_visit != "day0"]
  dd_lst <- split(d_mult_pbl[, .(date_var = paste(date_var, collapse = ", ")), 
                          by = setdiff(names(d_mult_pbl), "date_var")], by="ID")
  print(names(dd_lst))
  write_xlsx(x=dd_lst, path = 
               paste0("04_data_checks/", get_datetime_from_checksums(),
                      "_trouble_with_dates_post_bl_visits.xlsx"))
}
```


## Checks on analysis data

Check that all subject have compliance data
```{r}
## Check that we have compliance data on all subjects:
did <- readRDS(file = "02_data_derived/day0_all_subjects.rds")
all_id <- did$ID
if(!isTRUE(setequal(adat[!is.na(i_on_treat) | 
                         (f_visit == "day7" & d_today <= d_upr), 
                         unique(ID)], 
                    all_id))) {
  warning("Not all subjects have compliance data")
  ## Subjects without compliance data:
  id_wo_compliance <- all_id[!all_id %in% adat[!is.na(i_on_treat), unique(ID)]]
  id_wo_compliance
}
```

Check that `c_on_treat == "NR"` for baseline and all visits at or after the day 14 visit:
```{r}
is_NR <- adat[n_target == 0 | n_target >= 14, 
              isTRUE(all(!is.na(c_on_treat) & c_on_treat == "NR"))]
if(!is_NR) warning("Not all 'c_on_treat' are 'NR'")
```

Check that `c_on_treat %in% c("yes", "no")` visits between baseline and day 7:
```{r}
is_yes_no <- adat[n_target > 0 & n_target < 14, 
                  isTRUE(all(!is.na(c_on_treat) & c_on_treat %in% c("yes", "no")))]
if(!is_yes_no) warning("Not all 'c_on_treat' are 'yes' or 'no'")
```

## Check all individuals have lab results data on day 0 or day 7
```{r}
# Data on lab results
blood_data <- d0[category == "blod_data"]
blood_data[, value := c_value]
vital_data <- d0[category == "vital_data"]
lab_data <- rbind(blood_data[, .(ID, variable, c_visit, value)], 
                  vital_data[, .(ID, variable, c_visit, value)])
lab_data <- lab_data[!variable %in% c("mens_janej","mens_start", "hcg")]

# Extract missing data for a specific lab results and visit
get_missing_lab_tests <- function(data, lab_test, visit = "day0"){
  stopifnot(lab_test %in% data[, unique(variable)])
  ids <- all_id[!all_id %in% 
                  data[ID %in% all_id &  variable == lab_test & 
                         c_visit == visit & !is.na(value), unique(ID)]]
  res <- data.table(ID = ids, lab_test = lab_test, visit = visit)
  res
}

# Missing lab results on day 0
miss_lab_day0 <- rbindlist(lapply(lab_data[, unique(variable)], function(x) 
  get_missing_lab_tests(data = lab_data, lab_test = x, visit = "day0")))
write_xlsx(miss_lab_day0, path = 
             paste0("04_data_checks/", get_datetime_from_checksums(), 
                    "_missing_lab_results_day0.xlsx"))

# Missing lab results on day 7
miss_lab_day7 <- rbindlist(lapply(lab_data[, unique(variable)], function(x) 
  get_missing_lab_tests(data = lab_data, lab_test = x, visit = "day7")))
smiss_lab_day7 <- split(miss_lab_day7, by = "ID")
write_xlsx(smiss_lab_day7, path = 
             paste0("04_data_checks/", get_datetime_from_checksums(), 
                    "_missing_lab_results_day7.xlsx"))
```


## Checks on adverse events data

Check for invalid adverse event dates (Start date before day 0, end date before 
start date, or start date more than 10 days after day 0, missing start or end date)
```{r}
invalid_start_dates <- de[startdato < d_day0 | slutdato_haendelse < startdato |
                            as.numeric(startdato - d_day0) > 10 | 
                            is.na(slutdato_haendelse) | is.na(startdato), 
                          .(ID, haendelse, tekst, startdato, slutdato_haendelse, 
                            d_day0, hndelsesregistrering_complete)]
if (nrow(invalid_start_dates) > 0) {
  warning("Subjects with invalid adverse events dates")
  write_xlsx(invalid_start_dates, path = 
               paste0("04_data_checks/", get_datetime_from_checksums(),
                      "_invalid_adverse_event_dates.xlsx"))
}
```

Flag events with missing column values
```{r}
# Columns to check
check_cols <- c("investigator_alvorlighed", "gradering", "investigator_relation", 
                "status", "handling", "meddra_pt", "meddra_organ")

# Columns to return
key_cols <- c("ID", "haendelse", "meddra_pt","meddra_organ", "startdato", 
              "hndelsesregistrering_complete")

# Rows with missing columns
miss_reg <- lapply(check_cols, function(col) {
  dt <- de[is.na(get(col)), ..key_cols]
  dt[, missing := col]}) |> rbindlist() 

# Collapse if more than one missing variable for the same adverse event
miss_reg <- miss_reg[, .(missing = paste(missing, collapse = ", ")), 
                     by = setdiff(names(miss_reg), "missing")]

if (nrow(miss_reg) > 0) {
  warning("Subjects with missing adverse event column values")
  write_xlsx(miss_reg, 
             path = paste0("04_data_checks/", get_datetime_from_checksums(),
                           "_na_summary_adverse_events.xlsx"))
}
```

Flag all unverified or incomplete adverse event registrations

```{r}
if (nrow(non_complete_events) > 0) {
```

Flag all MedDRA preferred terms with more than one MedDRA system organ class:
```{r}
meddra_table <- de[, .(IDs = paste(unique(ID), collapse = ", ")), 
                    by = .(meddra_organ, meddra_pt)]

# Get the unique meddra_organ and IDs combinations per meddra_pt (preferred term)
meddra_table <- unique(meddra_table[, .(meddra_pt, meddra_organ, IDs)])

# Rank each meddra_organ entry within a meddra_pt group to generate column indices
meddra_table[, col_idx := seq_len(.N), by = meddra_pt]

if(meddra_table[, uniqueN(col_idx)] != 1) {
  warning("Multiple MedDRA organ classes for a pt")
  # Pivot meddra_organ values to wide format 
  soc_wide_organ <- dcast(meddra_table, meddra_pt ~ paste0("meddra_organ_", col_idx), 
                          value.var = "meddra_organ")

  # Pivot IDs values to wide format
  soc_wide_ids <- dcast(meddra_table, meddra_pt ~ paste0("meddra_organ_", col_idx, "_IDs"), 
                        value.var = "IDs")

  # Join the two wide tables together on meddra_pt
  meddra_table <- soc_wide_organ[soc_wide_ids, on = "meddra_pt"]
  meddra_table

  write_xlsx(meddra_table[!is.na(meddra_pt)], 
             path = paste0("04_data_checks/", get_datetime_from_checksums(),
                           "_meddra_classifications.xlsx"))
}
```

Flag individuals with more than one occurrence of the same MedDRA preferred term:
```{r}
# Find IDs with more than one event with the same level of meddra_pt
ids_w_duplicate_pt <- de[!is.na(meddra_pt), .(dates = list(startdato), N = .N), 
                          by = .(ID, meddra_pt)][N > 1]

# Collapse dates to one string per ID/meddra_pt combination
ids_w_duplicate_pt[, dates := sapply(dates, function(d) paste(sort(d), collapse = ", "))]

if(nrow(ids_w_duplicate_pt) > 0) {
  warning("Subjects with multiple occurences of the same MedDRA pt")
  write_xlsx(ids_w_duplicate_pt, 
             path = paste0("04_data_checks/", get_datetime_from_checksums(),
                           "_ids_w_duplicate_meddra_pt.xlsx"))
}
```


## Checks on admission, deaths and suicide attempts data

### Suicide attempts data

Flag inconsistent data
```{r}
# Check no subject have missing selvmord_outcome at a visit
stopifnot(nrow(ds[is.na(selvmord_outcome) & !is.na(c_visit)]) == 0)


# Check 1: selvmord_outcome != "Nej" but missing date, count and lethality
check1 <- ds[selvmord_outcome != "Nej" & 
                            (is.na(selvmord_outcome_dato) |
                               is.na(selvmord_outcome_antal) |
                               is.na(sevlmord_outcome_letalitet))]
check1[, note := "selvmord_outcome is not 'Nej' but missing date and/or count"]

# Check 2: selvmord_outcome == "Nej" but has date, count or lethality
check2 <- ds[selvmord_outcome == "Nej" & 
                            (!is.na(selvmord_outcome_dato) |
                               !is.na(selvmord_outcome_antal) |
                               !is.na(sevlmord_outcome_letalitet))]
check2[, note := "selvmord_outcome is 'Nej' but has date and/or count"]

# Check 3: d_day0 is after selvmord_outcome_dato
check3 <- ds[d_day0 > selvmord_outcome_dato]
check3[, note := "d_day0 > selvmord_outcome_dato"]

# Combine all failing rows into one dataset
suic_invalid_data <- rbind(check1, check2, check3)
if(nrow(suic_invalid_data) > 0){
  warning("Subjects with inconsistent data on suicide attempts")
  write_xlsx(suic_invalid_data, path = 
               paste0("04_data_checks/", get_datetime_from_checksums(),
                      "_suicide_attempt_violations.xlsx"))
}
```

### Admission and deaths data

Ensure consistency of binary and count and date variables
```{r}
# Check date of first hospital contact date exists for all individuals with 
# registered contact and binary indicator of admission matches count of admissions
inc_pam <- dc[((pam_6mdr != "Nej" | pam_dag28 != "Nej") & is.na(pam_dato_1)) |
                (pam_dag28 != "Ja" & pam_6mdr != "Ja" & pam_count > 0)][, 
          .(ID, pam_dag28, pam_6mdr, pam_dato_1, pam_count)]

inc_psyk <- dc[((indlagt_6mdr_psyk != "Nej" | indlagt_dag28_psyk != "Nej") & is.na(indlagt_psyk_start_1)) |
                 (indlagt_dag28_psyk != "Ja" & indlagt_6mdr_psyk != "Ja" & psyk_count > 0)][, 
          .(ID, indlagt_dag28_psyk, indlagt_6mdr_psyk, indlagt_psyk_start_1, psyk_count)]

inc_soma <- dc[((indlagt_6mdr_soma != "Nej" | indlagt_dag28_soma != "Nej") & is.na(indlagt_soma_start_1)) |
                 (indlagt_dag28_soma != "Ja" & indlagt_6mdr_soma != "Ja" & soma_count > 0)][, 
          .(ID, indlagt_dag28_soma, indlagt_6mdr_soma, indlagt_soma_start_1, soma_count)]

# Ensure that all death-related columns are non-missing for individuals with a 
# registered death
tmp <- dc[!is.na(doedsfald) | !is.na(type_doed) | !is.na(doedsaarsag) | !is.na(kommentar_doed)]
inc_death <- tmp[apply(tmp[, .(doedsfald, type_doed, doedsaarsag, kommentar_doed)], 1, anyNA)][, 
          .(ID, doedsfald, type_doed, doedsaarsag, kommentar_doed)]


if (nrow(inc_pam) > 0 | nrow(inc_psyk) > 0| nrow(inc_soma) > 0 | nrow(inc_death) > 0){
  warning("Subjects with inconsistent binary registration of admissions or death")
  dt_list <- list(
    PAM = inc_pam,
    psychiatric_admissions = inc_psyk,
    somatic_admissions = inc_soma,
    death = inc_death
  )
  # Only keep data.tables with at least one row
  dt_list <- dt_list[sapply(dt_list, nrow) > 0]
  write_xlsx(dt_list, path = paste0("04_data_checks/", get_datetime_from_checksums(), 
                      "_hospital_contacts_inconsistent_binary_registration.xlsx"))
}
```

Flag all individuals with violation of the order of hospital contact dates
```{r}
# Columns with all start dates of hospital contacts
pam_cols <- grep("^pam_dato_", names(dc), value = TRUE)
psyk_cols <- grep("^indlagt_psyk_start", names(dc), value = TRUE)
soma_cols <- grep("^indlagt_soma_start", names(dc), value = TRUE)

# Check date order for a single type of hospital contacts (PAM, inpatient psychiatric, 
# or somatic admissions)
check_date_order <- function(dt, cols) {
  all_cols <- c("d_day0", cols)
  
  dt[, order_violations := {
    viols <- c()
    for (i in seq_len(length(all_cols) - 1)) {
      if (!is.na(.SD[[all_cols[i + 1]]]) & .SD[[all_cols[i]]] > .SD[[all_cols[i + 1]]]) {
        viols <- paste(c(viols, paste0(all_cols[i], " > ", all_cols[i + 1])), 
                       collapse = ", ")
      }
    }
    if (length(viols) == 0) NA_character_ else paste(viols, collapse = ", ")
  }, by = seq_len(nrow(dt)), .SDcols = all_cols]
  
  dt[!is.na(order_violations)]
}

# Run check for all three types of hospital contacts and combine
order_viols <- unique(rbind(check_date_order(dc, pam_cols),
                                 check_date_order(dc, psyk_cols),
                                 check_date_order(dc, soma_cols)))

# Select relevant columns and collapse to one row per ID
order_viols <- order_viols[, .SD, .SDcols = c("ID", "d_day0","order_violations",
                                              pam_cols, psyk_cols, soma_cols)]
order_viols <- order_viols[, .(order_violations = paste(order_violations, collapse = ", ")), 
                                     by = c("ID", "d_day0", pam_cols, psyk_cols, soma_cols)]

# Save violations
if (nrow(order_viols) > 0){
  warning("Subjects with impossible order of dates for hospital contacts")
  write_xlsx(order_viols, path = 
               paste0("04_data_checks/", get_datetime_from_checksums(),
                      "_hospital_contact_date_order_violations.xlsx"))
}
```

```{r}
viol3 <- dc[(indlagt_dag28_soma != "Nej" & indlagt_6mdr_soma != "Ja") & 
                           indlagt_soma_start_1 > d_day28]
viol3[, note := "Somatic visit registered before day 28, but date of first somatic visit is after day 28"]

# Check no individuals with hospital contact at month 6 but not at day 28 has a 
# hospital contact before day 28
viol4 <- dc[(pam_dag28 != "Ja" & pam_6mdr != "Nej") & 
                           pam_dato_1 <= d_day28]
viol4[, note := "PAM visit not registred at day 28, but date of first PAM visit is on or before day 28"]

viol5 <- dc[(indlagt_dag28_psyk != "Ja" & indlagt_6mdr_psyk != "Nej") & 
                           indlagt_psyk_start_1 <= d_day28]
viol5[, note := "Psychiatric visit not registred at day 28, but date of first psychiatric visit is on or before day 28"]

viol6 <- dc[(indlagt_dag28_soma != "Ja" & indlagt_6mdr_soma != "Nej") & 
                           indlagt_soma_start_1 <= d_day28]
viol6[, note := "Somatic visit not registred at day 28, but date of first somatic visit is on or before day 28"]


viols <- rbind(viol1,viol2,viol3, viol4, viol5, viol6)
viols <- viols[, .(ID, d_day0, d_day28, pam_dag28, pam_6mdr, pam_dato_1, 
                   indlagt_dag28_psyk, indlagt_6mdr_psyk, indlagt_psyk_start_1, 
                   indlagt_dag28_soma, indlagt_6mdr_soma, indlagt_soma_start_1, note)]

if (nrow(viols) > 0){
  warning("Subjects with inconsistent dates of hospital contacts")
  write_xlsx(viols, path = paste0("04_data_checks/", get_datetime_from_checksums(),
                                  "_hospital_contacts_inconsistent_dates.xlsx"))
}
```

### Compare sources of admission data

Ensure all admissions/deaths are registered in "Alle indlæggelser" and "Dødsfald"
```{r}
# Alle indlæggelser og dødsfald
dc[, alle_indlaeggelser_og_doedsfald := paste0("n_PAM: ", pam_count,
                                         "; n_indlagt_psyk: ", psyk_count,
                                         "; n_indlagt_soma:", soma_count)]


# Indlæggelser og selvmordsforsøg siden sidst
psyk_adm <- ds[psyk_indl_outcome != "Nej" | selvmord_outcome != "Nej",
                          .SD[1], by = .(ID, psyk_indl_outcome_start)]
psyk_adm[, n_psyk := sum(as.numeric(psyk_indl_outcome_antal)), ID]
psyk_adm[, n_suic := sum(as.numeric(selvmord_outcome_antal)), ID]
psyk_adm[is.na(n_suic), n_suic := 0]
psyk_adm[, indlaeggelser_og_selvmordsforsoeg_siden_sidst := 
           paste0("n_indlagt_psyk: ", n_psyk, "; n_selvmordsforsoeg: ", n_suic)]

# Hændelser
sae_adm <- de[sae_kriterie == "Hospitalsindlæggelse eller forlængelse af hospitalsophold",
              .SD[1], by = .(ID, startdato)]
sae_adm[, n_haendelser := .N, ID]
sae_adm[, haendelser := paste0("n_sae_hospitalsindlaeggelse: ", n_haendelser)]

# Compare admission sources
registred_psyk <- unique(merge(merge(psyk_adm[
  , .(ID, indlaeggelser_og_selvmordsforsoeg_siden_sidst)],
  dc[, .(ID, alle_indlaeggelser_og_doedsfald)], all = TRUE),
  sae_adm[, .(ID, haendelser)], all = TRUE))

if (nrow(registred_psyk[is.na(alle_indlaeggelser_og_doedsfald)]) > 0){
  warning("Not all admissions registred in 'Alle indlæggelser'")
  write_xlsx(registreret_psyk, path = 
               paste0("04_data_checks/", get_datetime_from_checksums(), 
                      "_registred_admissions_and_suicide_attempts.xlsx"))
  }
```
